reason: Design-system review of 2026-11-20. ki-alert: onmars v2 tints each tone's card, edges it with a hairline and lays it flat, and a non-neutral alert without a slotted icon draws its tone's glyph (spec 011 A2). ki-pagination fills its row. ki-timeline-item draws a solid dot for a toned event without an icon (spec 114 S13). ki-fab-menu gains --ki-fab-menu-trigger-bg/fg for its closed default trigger and ki-fab-menu-item --ki-fab-menu-item-border-width/color; ki-audio's speed and mute controls read the quaternary button fill and ink. Token values change in onmars v2 (alert, avatar, fab-menu, fab-menu-item, tonal med-em inks, secondary text on success, caption-1, overline and display line heights) and Material 3 (tonal med-em and low-em inks in light, secondary text on success); 92 token descriptions now describe onmars v2. Value changes of published tokens classify as major; nothing is published at that baseline (0.0.0). No token, prop, event, part or slot is removed or renamed.
